manufacturerDisplay: Marketed by La Renon Healthcare Pvt. Ltd.; manufactured by Ravian Life Science Pvt. Ltd., Haridwar
uses: Used with other medicines to help prevent the body from rejecting a transplanted organ (such as kidney, heart or liver).
warnings: Can cause pregnancy loss and birth defects. Needs reliable contraception under a doctor's guidance.
Raises the risk of serious infections and some cancers (for example skin cancer and lymphoma).
Take only exactly as prescribed by the transplant team.

drugClass: Blood pressure medicine (calcium channel blocker + beta blocker)
manufacturerDisplay: Mankind Pharma Ltd. (Mfg. Lic. No. M/743/2016)
uses: Used to treat high blood pressure, usually when one medicine alone is not enough.
sideEffects: Slow heartbeat, cold hands and feet
warnings: Do not stop suddenly. Stopping atenolol abruptly can be harmful.
Atenolol can hide warning signs of low blood sugar in people with diabetes.
Tell your doctor if you have asthma, heart failure or very slow pulse.

dosageForm: Uncoated bilayered tablet (metformin in prolonged-release form)
manufacturerDisplay: Marketed by Primus Remedies Pvt. Ltd.
uses: Used to control blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes, together with diet and exercise.
sideEffects: Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach upset, metallic taste
Low blood sugar (sweating, shaking, hunger, confusion)
warnings: Low blood sugar can be serious. Keep a fast-acting sugar source nearby and do not skip meals.
Rarely, metformin causes lactic acidosis. Seek urgent help for unusual weakness, fast breathing or severe stomach pain.
Limit alcohol and tell your doctor before scans with contrast dye or surgery.

drugClass: Cold and allergy symptom relief (pain/fever reducer + antihistamine + decongestant)
uses: Used for short-term relief of cold and flu symptoms such as fever, headache, runny nose, sneezing and blocked nose.
sideEffects: Raised blood pressure or fast heartbeat (from the decongestant)
warnings: Do not take other paracetamol products at the same time. Too much paracetamol can damage the liver.
People with high blood pressure or heart disease should ask a doctor first.
